title: 第23章 万家灯火第24章 挖墙脚
slug: 我金丹呢你当结石摘出来了
lines: 烤肉店里安静了足足三秒。
王丹丹盯着苏业的手机屏幕，嘴巴微微张着，眼睛都快瞪圆了，王罗更夸张，整个人都快从椅子上扑过去了，恨不得把屏幕抠下来仔细看看，是不是系统出bug了。
省第一。
这个分量，太重了。
执医证考试是什么概念，她们都清楚得很，全省范围内，刚毕业的医学本科生、硕士、规培生、各大医院的年轻医生，全部放在一起考核，比的不只是脑子，还有积累、临床思维、应试经验。
能过，已经很难得了。
可苏业不声不响，直接拿了个省第一。
这已经不是优秀了。
这是碾压。
苏业却只是低头看了一眼。
其实在他看来，这个成绩再正常不过了。
说到底，执医证考试的核心仍然是基础理论知识，是考点，是框架、记忆、理解，只要掌握了足够多的知识点，再把这些知识点在脑海里归纳整理，考场上快速调用，拿高分其实并不难。
而这些东西，对如今的苏业来说，恰恰是最简单的。
死记硬背就能拿分的东西。
这不是小儿科吗？
但身边这三个人可不这么想。
王丹丹缓缓放下手机，看着苏业，眼神有点恍惚。
“省第一啊……”
她的声音都轻了几分。
这意味着什么？
意味着苏业以后想要留在院里，基本已经是板上钉钉的事了，规培期间只要不出什么大问题，技能考核再稳一点，医院这边根本不可能放走这样的人。
再往后呢？
主治，副高，甚至更远一点，调去省医院，去更大的平台。
未来不可限量。
他们还在为了一个“能不能合格留院”发愁，人家已经站在另一个起点上了。
王罗张了张嘴，忽然觉得嘴里的肉都不香了。
羡慕。
甚至还有点挫败。
大家都是规培生，天天一起上班，一起跟台，一起挨骂，怎么人和人的差距就能大成这样？
王丹丹叹了口气，往后一靠，双手摊开，一副认命的模样。
“这就是怪物吧。”
他们和苏业认识的时间其实不算长，可这个家伙给人的感觉就是这样，强，太强了，这家伙拿的应该就是强者模板，好像不管把他丢到什么环境里，他都能很快适应，并且以强者的姿态君临天下，令人唏嘘啊。
王罗以前总说苏业是他们学校的神话，她之前还觉得夸张，现在她算是理解了何为神话。
“我服了。”王罗放下夹子，认真地说道，“苏哥，以后你发达了别忘了兄弟。”
苏业瞥了他一眼。
“你戏挺多。”
content_en:
The barbecue restaurant was quiet for three seconds.
Wang Dandan stared at Su Ye's mobile phone screen, his mouth slightly open, and his eyes almost widened. Wang Luo was even more exaggerated. He almost jumped out of the chair and wanted to take off the screen and take a closer look to see if there was a bug in the system.
First in the province.
This weight is too heavy.
They all know the concept of the medical license examination very well. Across the province, newly graduated medical undergraduates, masters, regular trainees, and young doctors from major hospitals are all assessed together. It is not just their brains that are compared, but also their accumulation, clinical thinking, and exam-taking experience.
It’s already very rare to be able to pass.
But Su ye didn't say anything and directly won the first place in the province.
This is no longer excellent.
This is crushing.
Su ye just looked down.
In fact, in his opinion, this result is perfectly normal.
In the final analysis, the core of the medical license examination is still basic theoretical knowledge, test points, framework, memory, and understanding. As long as you master enough knowledge points, summarize these knowledge points in your mind, and quickly call them in the examination room, it is not difficult to get high scores.
And these things are the simplest for Su ye today.
Things that you can get points by memorizing by rote.
Isn't this child's play?
But the three people around him didn't think so.
Wang Dandan slowly put down the phone and looked at Su ye, his eyes a little dazed.
"No. 1 in the province..."
Her voice became a little softer.
what does that mean?
This means that it is basically a certainty that Su ye wants to stay in the hospital in the future. As long as there are no major problems during the training period and the skill assessment is more stable, it is impossible for the hospital to let such a person go.
What next?
Attending, deputy chief, or even a little further, transferred to the provincial hospital, to a larger platform.
The future is limitless.
They are still worrying about "whether they can be qualified to stay in the hospital", but they are already at a different starting point.
Wang Luo opened his mouth, and suddenly felt that the meat in his mouth was no longer fragrant.
envious.
Even a little frustrated.
We are all trainees. We go to work together, talk to the stage together, and get scolded together every day. How can the gap between people be so big?
Wang Dandan sighed, leaned back and spread his hands, looking resigned to his fate.
"This must be a monster."
They didn't know Su Ye for a long time, but this guy gave people the impression that he was strong, too strong. This guy should have taken the template of a strong man. It seemed that no matter what environment he was thrown into, he could adapt quickly and dominate the world as a strong man, which was embarrassing.
Wang Luo always said that Su Ye was the myth of their school. She thought it was exaggerated before, but now she finally understood what a myth was.
"I'm convinced." Wang Luo put down the clip and said seriously, "Brother Su, don't forget your brother when you get rich."
Su ye glanced at him.
"You play a lot."
